name: ig-comment-dm
description: AutoDM: free, self-hosted Instagram comment-to-DM automation on Cloudflare Workers, using only Meta's official Instagram API.

META_APP_SECRET.description: Meta **App secret** (App settings → Basic). Put `temp` first if you don't have it yet.

IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Token from Meta → Instagram → API setup → **Generate token**. Put `temp` first if you don't have it yet.

WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN.description: Any random text. Paste the same value into Meta's **Verify token** box. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 16`.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for your AutoDM dashboard. Use a long one.

DB.description: Stores your automations and activity. Created automatically.
